purpose: Own Algebra 1 Portfolio status, Mastery Goal grades, PowerSchool MG exports, intervention routing, practice-link behavior, and recurring report fidelity while Unit Assessment Plans own exact learning content.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, with at least one reasonably current demonstration.
mastered_default_rule.rich_artifact_exception: A rich artifact may be sufficient when it contains multiple genuinely independent convincing demonstrations.
mastered_default_rule.later_weak_event: One later weak event does not automatically remove established mastery; record meaningful contradiction for review.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.demonstrated_when: At least 2 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer.

mastery_goal_grade_model.not_assessed_rule: If no usable evidence exists on any I Can in the Mastery Goal, assessed=false and family-facing display is `Not assessed`; PowerSchool Score remains blank.

scale.label: In Progress
scale.rule: Goal is assessed and 0 or 1 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer

scale.label: Meeting
scale.rule: 2 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer

scale.label: Advancing
scale.rule: 3 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer

scale.label: Mastery
scale.rule: All 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer

scale.label: Mastery + Transfer
scale.rule: All 4 are Mastered or Transfer plus meaningful transfer/extension evidence in this goal

mastery_goal_grade_model.calculation_rule: Use current longitudinal I Can status; never average attempts or assignment percentages.
mastery_goal_grade_model.unit_grade_rule: No overall Unit letter grade is reported or exported. Unit Mastery Goals demonstrated remains a progress count only.

powerschool.output_rule: Produce one CSV per Mastery Goal per period on every successful evidence run; no Unit-grade CSV.
powerschool.template_rule: Reuse stored PowerSchool template shape. Preserve non-grade metadata/roster fields except the deterministic MG assignment name and current Score values.

student_practice_link.portfolio_qr_rule: QR and clickable link open Unit only with nothing preselected.
student_practice_link.focus_list_rule: Report lists all current practice-focus I Cans as exact code + full statement.
student_practice_link.privacy_rule: No student identity or evidence in URL/QR.
student_practice_link.student_bank_role: Legacy/reference viewer; not the Portfolio report QR destination.
student_practice_link.family_selection: Bank families remain curriculum/evidence architecture. The student Practice Builder does not expose Family A/B/C controls.

intervention_routing.whole_class: Recommend only for a genuinely broad shared instructional need; do not infer from No Evidence or raw frequency alone.
intervention_routing.priority_day_group: At least two students sharing the exact same current substantial-gap bundle of 2-4 I Cans. Never use a single shared I Can as the primary grouping rule.
intervention_routing.pull_in_students: Student-centered 1-2 small/actionable gaps; personalized practice/check while teacher circulates.
intervention_routing.ready_for_recheck: Students who only need another independent demonstration stay out of intervention lanes.

report_fidelity.rule: Registered Portfolio templates own recurring headings, table/card anatomy, QR block, visual layout, Mastery Goal grade display, and intervention lanes. Fill declared data slots; do not redesign per run.
report_fidelity.mastery_goal_grade_rule: Populate all four current Mastery Goal grades. A completely unassessed goal displays Not assessed. Do not calculate or display an overall Unit letter grade.
report_fidelity.student_recent_evidence_exception: The approved Recent evidence table may show Convincing/Partial/Limited/Unusable as a compact evidence descriptor.
report_fidelity.teacher_name_rule: Use compact first-name + last-initial lists where needed. Group by period only when useful; do not append period after every name.
report_fidelity.student_action_rule: Use only the fixed student next-action vocabulary declared by the Portfolio template contract.

student_next_action.principle: I Can proficiency status and student next action are separate.

states.label: Practice + check soon
states.rule: Developing without one convincing independent demonstration, or a clear current gap should be repaired before another independent check.

states.label: Needs another independent check
states.rule: Developing with one convincing independent demonstration but not yet enough independent convincing evidence for Mastered.

states.label: Secure
states.rule: Current I Can status is Mastered.

states.label: Extension
states.rule: Current I Can status is Transfer, or routine nearby targets are secure and a legitimate transfer/extension move is selected.

student_next_action.page_2_rule: Every I Can row shows one compact Next label from the five states.

quick_check.live_selection_rule: Curriculum predicts evidence slots. Portfolio selects current reassessment I Cans from live need. Teacher approves/edits actual questions.
quick_check.mapping_rule: Map the clean task before judging handwriting. A task may provide separately judgeable evidence for more than one I Can when the task genuinely contains both evidence jobs; those judgments still share the same source opportunity unless independence is explicitly supported.
quick_check.same_source_rule: Repeated prompts for one I Can on the same Quick Check are not automatically independent opportunities. Source maps may require a single synthesized source-level judgment.
quick_check.teacher_selector_rule: The unit builder shows four slots with exact I Can choices and Bank-derived family possibilities. Live Portfolio need may guide reassessment recommendations when available; otherwise the eligible pool is shown. Teacher selection is final.
quick_check.teacher_note_rule: The unit builder includes an optional fine-tuning note beside the request action. It may tune surface/layout/value choices but may not silently change selected I Can, family evidence job, or difficulty.
quick_check.version_rule: Four versions A-D use the same four teacher-approved evidence architectures. Normal differences are simple number/value swaps, deterministic question-order scrambling, and answer-choice scrambling when applicable. Do not redesign questions merely to create versions.
quick_check.source_map_rule: For newly generated approved Quick Checks, the sibling approved quick_N_S.json is the primary exact lineage/source map. curriculum/quick_check_source_maps is reserved for legacy/special aggregation, multi-target overrides, compatibility, or missing approved JSON.

teacher_summary.class_overview: Intervention-first overview using exactly Whole Class, Priority Day Group, and Pull In Students.
teacher_summary.priority_day_group: Group students only by the exact same 2-4-I-Can substantial-gap bundle; no single-I-Can priority groups.
teacher_summary.pull_in_students: Student-centered 1-2 gap list; do not group under I Can headings.
teacher_summary.appendix: Detailed I Can evidence remains reference material after intervention pages; continue pages as needed so names never clip.

legacy_retirements: Not Yet / Approaching / Meeting / Exceeding as current Algebra Portfolio status labels
fixed previous-section Exit Ticket reassessment chain
Student Bank as the printed Portfolio report QR destination
overall Unit letter grade as the official PowerSchool Portfolio grade
